		icon = GFX_decision_generic_police_action
		allowed = { original_tag = PAK }
		visible = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_dec_martial_law_regime
			OR = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_martial_law has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_guided_order }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_politics_banned }
		}
		cost = 50
		days_re_enable = 365
		fire_only_once = no
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_PAK_ban_political_activity"
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_politics_allowed } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_politics_allowed }
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_politics_banned
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_PAK_outlook_western_m3_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { GEN_1970_outlook_start = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { GEN_1970_outlook_end = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { GEN_1970_outlook_change = -0.03 }
				GEN_1970_change_outlook_popularity = yes
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
		}

			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_dec_switch_to_bomb
